import csv
import math
import sys

input_path = sys.argv[1]
required = {"rowname", "log2FoldChange", "padj"}
seen = set()
background = []
foreground = []

with open(input_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
    reader = csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter="\t")
    if reader.fieldnames is None or not required.issubset(set(reader.fieldnames)):
        raise SystemExit("Input must contain rowname, log2FoldChange, and padj columns")
    for row_number, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):
        gene_id = (row.get("rowname") or "").strip()
        if not gene_id:
            raise SystemExit("Blank gene identifier at input row %d" % row_number)
        if gene_id in seen:
            raise SystemExit("Duplicate gene identifier: %s" % gene_id)
        seen.add(gene_id)
        background.append(gene_id)
        try:
            lfc = float(row["log2FoldChange"])
            padj = float(row["padj"])
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
        if math.isfinite(lfc) and math.isfinite(padj) and lfc > 0 and abs(lfc) >= 1.5 and padj <= 0.05:
            foreground.append(gene_id)

with open("foreground.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
    handle.write("gene_id\n")
    handle.write("\n".join(foreground))
    handle.write("\n")

with open("background.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
    handle.write("gene_id\n")
    handle.write("\n".join(background))
    handle.write("\n")
PY
